svg.title: Megakaryocyte
svg.desc: Very large marrow cell with polyploid multilobed nucleus and cytoplasmic extensions shedding platelets. Biological basis: Megakaryocytes form proplatelet extensions whose terminal cytoplasmic fragments enter marrow sinusoids as platelets.
